content: Tanukra
Umi iɛdu ssebt, tesɣa Maryam n Majdala d Maryam, yemmas n Yaɛqub, d Salumi řeɛṭur ḥima ad t dehnent.
Ɣar ṣṣbeḥ zic deg wass amezwar n ssimana iwḍent-i-dd ɣar wenḍeř, ařami dd-tenqar tfuct.
Nnant jar asent: “Wi d aneɣ i ɣa isseqnunnyen taṣḍart nni iǧan x wadaf n wenḍeř?”
Řami xzarent, ẓrint aqa taṣḍart tᵉttwasseqnunni zeg wenḍeř, waxxa tuɣa temɣar aṭṭas.
Řami udfent ɣar yifři n wenḍeř, ẓrint ijj n ubřiɣ iqqim ɣar uɣezdis afusi, yarḍ arruḍ d acemřař, uca nitenti nnxeřɛent.
Maca netta inna asent: “War ttnexřiɛent ca! Kennint tarezzunt x Yasuɛ Nnaṣiri wenni ittwaṣellben. Aqa Netta ikkar, war da iǧi, xzarent, aqa amcan mani t ssarsen.
Maca ruḥent, inint i imeḥḍaren nnes uřa i Buṭrus, aqa ad awem izwar ɣar Ljalil. Dinni ad t tẓarem am mammec tuɣa i d awem inna.”
Ffɣent deɣya uca arewřent zeg wenḍeř, minzi tqebs i-tent tarjijit d ddehcan, uca war t nnint i ḥed, minzi tuɣa ggʷedent.
Aḍḥar n Yasuɛ awarni i tnukra nnes
Ɣar ṣṣbeḥ zic deg wass amezwar n ssimana ikkar-dd uca iḍhar-dd d amezwaru i Maryam n Majdala, tenni zi tuɣa issuffeɣ sebɛa n ccwaṭen.
Tanita truḥ uca txebbar aya i yinni tuɣa akides iǧan, inni tuɣa iceḍnen u ttrun.
Řami ina sřin belli Netta aqa iddar uca iban asent, war zzaysent uminen.
Awarni aya iban-dd s yijj n waddud nneɣni i tnayen zzaysen, umi tuɣa gguren nitni ɣar ijj n dcar.
Uřa d ina ruḥen ɛawed uca xebbaren inneɣni, maca war uminen uřa d ina.

Ɣar uneggar iban-dd i ḥiṭac ařami tuɣa qqimen ɣar ṭṭabřa uca iɛayar i-ten zi ssibbet n tikkest n l’iman nsen u zi ssibbet n řeqsaḥet n wuřawen nsen, minzi war uminen zeg inni t iẓrin awarni řami dd-ittwassnekkar Netta.
Řumur ameqqran i ubarreḥ n Řexbar Aṣebḥan
Inna asen: “Ruḥem ɣar ddunect marra, barrḥem s Řexbar Aṣebḥan di marra min dd-ittwaxeřqen.
Wenni yuminen u ittwasseɣḍeṣ, aqa iddar, maca wenni war yuminen, aqa ittwaḥaseb.
Tina d řeɛřamat i ɣa iḍfaren inni yuminen: aqa nitni ad ssuffɣen ccwaṭen s Yisem inu, ad ssiwřen s iřsawen n jdid,
ad ksin ifiɣran s ifassen nsen u mařa swin min ineqqen, war ten iḍḍarri ca man aya, uca ad ssarsen ifassen nsen x imehřac, ad ggenfan.”
Tameksit n Yasuɛ ɣar ujenna
Awarni řami kidsen issiweř, immeksi Siditneɣ Yasuɛ ɣar ujenna uca issɣim Ixef nnes x ufusi n AREBBI.
Maca nitni ffɣen uca barrḥen di kuř amcan, u Siditneɣ tuɣa iɛawen i-ten uca issars řxeṭ nnes x wawařen nsen s řeɛřamat i yeggin. Amin.
Aneggar n L’Injil Iqeddsen am mammec t ibarreḥ Markus.
